detail: Baseline validation failed before developer ran

result.summary: All AC met. Intent fulfilled. No verify commands in the active backlog mutate backlog state (AC1 pass). Both groomer.md and prompt-groom-hints.md now contain explicit stateless-verify-commands guidance (AC2 pass). Bonus: a lint warning was added to check_readiness_gates() — wired to backlog check via cmd-backlog-read.sh — that flags any verify command containing backlog add or backlog rm before a sprint begins.

ac_results.summary: jq scan of backlog.json and bugs.json finds no verify commands containing 'backlog add' or 'backlog rm'
Both .aishore/templates/prompt-groom-hints.md and .aishore/agents/groomer.md contain 'stateless' and explicit warnings against backlog add/rm in verify commands
